Candidate actions per unit from the P4 diagnosis (spec 072, actions.md)

Source: R/p4_actions.R
p4_actions_candidates.Rd

Stage 2 of the P4-driven action plan, deterministic and LLM-free. For each unit, applies the rules of p4_regles_actions():

  • signal only (P4 below the minimum NDP, or p4_signal_seulement): a single data-acquisition action, nothing else (guard 4);

  • otherwise the rule of the P4 decision and Pareto status, one rule per hazard whose expected loss exceeds seuil_alea, and the exposure reduction rule for a concentrating unit of a hazard above the exposure cap.

Usage

p4_actions_candidates(
  ugf_p4,
  pareto = NULL,
  ruine = NULL,
  regles = NULL,
  parametres = NULL,
  id_field = NULL,
  vocation_field = "vocation",
  garde_profil = NULL
)

Arguments

ugf_p4

Output of indicateur_p4_rendement_net().

pareto

Output of p4_pareto(), or one status (domine / non_domine / NA) per unit. An unknown status is treated as non_domine (no automatic harvest).

ruine

Output of p4_ruine_foret() (same id_field convention), or NULL.

regles

Rules, default p4_regles_actions().

parametres

P4 parameters, default p4_parametres() (only their version is recorded).

id_field

Unit identifier column (default: row position, as in p4_ruine_foret()).

vocation_field

Vocation column.

garde_profil

NULL, or a function receiving the candidate table and returning one logical per row (TRUE = keep): guard 3, supplied by the application from the thresholds of the actor profiles.

Value

A data frame, one row per unit and action: ugf, action_id, regle, origine (decision, alea, concentrante, signal), alea, tableau (coupes, travaux, aucun), recolte, libelle, the P4 values used (p4_rendement_net, p4_ecart, p4_decision, p4_ndp, p4_signal_seulement, pareto_statut, perte_alea), version_parametres, version_regles, regles_provisoires and prelevement_max_part_capital (the bound of the rules file carried by every harvesting action, guard 5). Attribute ecartees: the removed candidates with their garde.

Details

Guards (brief B6): 1 vocation (no harvest outside the vocations of vocations_recolte), 4 precision, 6 traceability (each action keeps its rule, the P4 values used and the versions of parameters and rules). Guard 2 (protected axes) and guard 5 (extent bounds) act on the options, see p4_options(). Guard 3 (alert thresholds of the actor profiles) lives in the application: it is exposed as garde_profil. Removed candidates are not lost: they are kept, with the guard that removed them, in the attribute ecartees.

Examples

u <- data.frame(vocation = "production", capital = 14000, gain_valeur = 750,
                surface_ha = 12, R1_norm = 70, R2_norm = 40, R3_norm = 45, R4_norm = 80)
u <- suppressMessages(indicateur_p4_rendement_net(u, ndp = 3))
p4_actions_candidates(u)[, c("action_id", "regle", "tableau")]
#>                             action_id        regle tableau
#> 1  pas_de_coupe_au_dela_accroissement           D1 travaux
#> 2        eclaircie_precoce_rapport_hd    A_tempete  coupes
#> 3                 traitement_lisieres    A_tempete travaux
#> 4 recolte_anticipee_peuplements_hauts    A_tempete  coupes
#> 5            diversification_essences A_secheresse travaux
#> 6                   recolte_sanitaire A_secheresse  coupes
#> 7             suivi_sanitaire_spec008 A_secheresse travaux
#> 8                  adaptation_densite A_secheresse  coupes
